user.title: Add Wallbox charger
user.description: Pick the Wallbox charger to control over Bluetooth. Make sure the Wallbox phone app's Bluetooth is disconnected (the charger allows only one BLE connection at a time).

data.pin: BLE PIN (only if set in the Wallbox app)

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Add the Wallbox charger {name}? If you set a BLE PIN in the Wallbox app, enter it below; otherwise leave it blank.

abort.no_devices_found: No Wallbox chargers were found over Bluetooth. Make sure the charger is in range and the phone app's Bluetooth is disconnected.

init.title: Wallbox BLE options
init.description: How often to poll the charger over Bluetooth. Lower is more responsive but adds BLE traffic; 15s is a good default.
